title: Language of bad encodings
statement: Let $C_w,c_w$ be natural numbers and let $M$ be a finite-tape Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet. The language consists of precisely those Boolean words $z$ for which the valuation of machine atoms obtained by evaluating them with parameters $C_w,c_w,M$ on $z$ satisfies the bad-valuation condition.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-tape Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet
